candidates.evidence: The only strong band (108.9 cm-1, FWHM 4.3 cm-1, ~11,000 counts above baseline) sits where CrI3 literature places a strong low-frequency A-type mode, and the semantic search returned several CrI3 Raman papers (arXiv:1807.03259, arXiv:1803.10825, arXiv:1910.04542). I did not open those papers, so the mode table is unverified and this rests on recall. Against it: the expected higher-frequency CrI3 modes (about 130 and 165 cm-1 in my recollection) are not clearly present, and the 142.7 cm-1 band is weak.
Recall-based, unverified: alpha-In2Se3 has a low-frequency mode near 105-110 cm-1, but its strong A1 modes near 175-200 cm-1 are absent here, which argues against it.
Recall-based, unverified: an Ag-type mode near 109 cm-1 is reported for SnSe, but its strong ~150 and ~186 cm-1 modes are not seen in this spectrum.

Recall-based, unverified: expected modes near 62, 103 and 135 cm-1 do not fit the observed 109 and 143 cm-1 bands (offsets of about 6-8 cm-1); the 62 cm-1 mode lies at the edge of the measured window.
Recall-based, unverified: low-frequency modes near 112-113 cm-1 are reported, but the strong modes near 165 and 213 cm-1 are not seen here, which argues against it.

limits: Spectral window is only 60-1099 cm-1. Strong modes above 1100 cm-1 and below 60 cm-1 are not measured, so the identification is limited; this is the main reason the material cannot be fixed.
No Si substrate line at 520.7 cm-1 is detected (fit amplitude collapses to zero), so no Si calibration was possible and absolute shifts are uncertain by a few tenths of a cm-1 or more.

No reference-library matching was run. The skill's reference library and matching script are outside the working folder, which I was told not to read. The candidate ranking is from recall and the literature search, not from a computed Raman database, and the confidences are rough.

Weak structure remains unassigned. After removing the two spikes and a baseline, a smoothed residual shows about 17 maxima at 2.5-5 sigma between 240 and 1040 cm-1 (strongest near 241.7, 388.6, 432.4, 620.8, 761.8, 902.7 cm-1). Noise is about 210 counts per point (about 80 counts after 7-point smoothing). These are not confirmed as modes and are not reported as peaks; a longer acquisition would be needed.
The 142.7 cm-1 band is weak (about 1,300 counts) with a broad width; its significance rests on one fit and is not verified by a second spectrum.
Expected CrI3 modes at about 130 and 165 cm-1 (from recall, not verified) are not clearly present, which weakens the CrI3 candidate.

Rejected: Bi2Te3 (expected 62/103/135 cm-1 pattern does not fit), Td/1T'-WTe2 (expected strong 165 and 213 cm-1 absent), SnSe and alpha-In2Se3 (their strong modes at about 150-200 cm-1 absent). The TMD fingerprint modes near 300-420 cm-1 are not seen as strong bands, which argues against common 2H-TMDs.
Polarization, temperature dependence, laser power and a second spectrum were not available, so the bands cannot be checked for symmetry, heating or reproducibility. Assignments are not made.
The working-folder name was not used as evidence for the material identity.
